grammar.explanation: 愿意 expresses willingness or preference, not just learned ability or permission. 我愿意帮忙，可是今晚不方便 separates being willing from being free. 不愿意 can sound like a direct refusal; give an honest reason or alternative when appropriate. 愿意不愿意 asks about willingness, while 方便吗 asks about availability.

examples.zh: 我愿意参加，可是今天有事。
examples.py: wǒ yuàn yì cān jiā , kě shì jīn tiān yǒu shì .
examples.en: I am willing to join, but I have something on today.

examples.zh: 你愿意不愿意星期六来？愿意，但时间还要商量。
examples.py: nǐ yuàn yì bù yuàn yì xīng qī liù lái ? yuàn yì , dàn shí jiān hái yào shāng liang .
examples.en: Are you willing to come on Saturday? Yes, but we still need to discuss the time.

commonMistakes.why: State the action after 愿意; 星期六 alone is a time, not the willing action.

grammar.explanation: 还是…吧 proposes a preferable option after considering alternatives: 太晚了，还是星期六见吧. This is different from a choice question 星期五还是星期六. The proposal is not accepted until the other person agrees. A gentler refusal can acknowledge the invitation, state the difficulty and propose another time.

examples.zh: 今晚太晚了，还是星期六见吧。
examples.py: jīn wǎn tài wǎn le , hái shi xīng qī liù jiàn ba .
examples.en: Tonight is too late; let us meet on Saturday instead.

examples.zh: 你星期五还是星期六方便？星期六。还是星期六吧。
examples.py: nǐ xīng qī wǔ hái shi xīng qī liù fāng biàn ? xīng qī liù . hái shi xīng qī liù ba .
examples.en: Is Friday or Saturday convenient? Saturday. Let us choose Saturday, then.

commonMistakes.wrong: 今晚还是星期六见吧吗？
commonMistakes.right: 今晚不方便，还是星期六见吧。
commonMistakes.why: Do not append 吗 to the 吧 suggestion; explain why Saturday is preferable.

dialogue.title: A refusal is not a broken friendship
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the actual agreement rather than infer it from politeness.

lines.zh: 今晚来我家吃饭，愿意吗？
lines.py: jīn wǎn lái wǒ jiā chī fàn , yuàn yì ma ?
lines.en: Would you like to come to my home for dinner tonight?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 愿意，可是最近下班很晚，今晚不方便。
lines.py: yuàn yì , kě shì zuì jìn xià bān hěn wǎn , jīn wǎn bù fāng biàn .
lines.en: I would, but I have been finishing work late, and tonight is inconvenient.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我还没答应别人，原来的计划就是今晚。
lines.py: wǒ hái méi dā ying bié ren , yuán lái de jì huà jiù shì jīn wǎn .
lines.en: I have not promised anyone else; the original plan was tonight.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我有点难受，也怕太晚回家。我们换一天，好吗？
lines.py: wǒ yǒu diǎn nán shòu , yě pà tài wǎn huí jiā . wǒ men huàn yī tiān , hǎo ma ?
lines.en: I feel a little unwell and worry about getting home too late. Could we choose another day?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 听到你不来，我有点难过。不过我相信你不是不愿意。
lines.py: tīng dào nǐ bù lái , wǒ yǒu diǎn nán guò . bù guò wǒ xiāng xìn nǐ bù shì bù yuàn yì .
lines.en: I feel a little sad that you are not coming, but I believe it is not that you do not want to.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 谢谢。我的想法是改时间，还是星期六见吧。
lines.py: xiè xiè . wǒ de xiǎng fa shì gǎi shí jiān , hái shi xīng qī liù jiàn ba .
lines.en: Thank you. My idea is to change the time; let us meet on Saturday instead.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 星期六我休假，也许方便。但假期的计划还没定。
lines.py: xīng qī liù wǒ xiū jià , yě xǔ fāng biàn . dàn jià qī de jì huà hái méi dìng .
lines.en: I am on leave on Saturday, so perhaps it is convenient, but my holiday plans are not settled.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那先商量，不一定现在就定。你有什么意见？
lines.py: nà xiān shāng liang , bù yí dìng xiàn zài jiù dìng . nǐ yǒu shén me yì jian ?
lines.en: Then let us discuss it first; we do not have to settle it now. What do you think?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我打算先休息，心情好一点再见朋友。
lines.py: wǒ dǎ suan xiān xiū xī , xīn qíng hǎo yī diǎn zài jiàn péng you .
lines.en: I plan to rest first and see friends when I feel a little better.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行，我改变计划，先问你星期六几点方便。
lines.py: xíng , wǒ gǎi biàn jì huà , xiān wèn nǐ xīng qī liù jǐ diǎn fāng biàn .
lines.en: Okay; I will change the plan and ask what time Saturday is convenient.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 现在还不知道，明天告诉你，可以吗？
lines.py: xiàn zài hái bù zhī dào , míng tiān gào sù nǐ , kě yǐ ma ?
lines.en: I do not know yet; may I tell you tomorrow?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 可以，放心。今晚先休息，明天再定。
lines.py: kě yǐ , fàng xīn . jīn wǎn xiān xiū xī , míng tiān zài dìng .
lines.en: Yes, do not worry. Rest tonight; we will decide tomorrow.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 朋友请我今晚吃饭。我愿意去，可是最近下班晚，今天还有点难受。
lines.py: péng you qǐng wǒ jīn wǎn chī fàn . wǒ yuàn yì qù , kě shì zuì jìn xià bān wǎn , jīn tiān hái yǒu diǎn nán shòu .
lines.en: A friend invited me for dinner tonight. I would like to go, but work has been finishing late and I feel a little unwell today.

lines.zh: 我怕太晚回家，明天会累，所以没有答应今晚去。
lines.py: wǒ pà tài wǎn huí jiā , míng tiān huì lèi , suǒ yǐ méi yǒu dā ying jīn wǎn qù .
lines.en: I worry I would get home too late and be tired tomorrow, so I did not agree to go tonight.

lines.zh: 我请求换一天，说还是星期六见吧。这是我的想法，不是已经定好的时间。
lines.py: wǒ qǐng qiú huàn yī tiān , shuō hái shi xīng qī liù jiàn ba . zhè shì wǒ de xiǎng fa , bù shì yǐ jīng dìng hǎo de shí jiān .
lines.en: I asked to change the day and suggested Saturday. It is my idea, not an already settled appointment.

lines.zh: 朋友有点难过，但相信我不是不愿意。她说星期六休假，也许方便。
lines.py: péng you yǒu diǎn nán guò , dàn xiāng xìn wǒ bù shì bù yuàn yì . tā shuō xīng qī liù xiū jià , yě xǔ fāng biàn .
lines.en: My friend felt a little sad but believed I was not unwilling. She said she was on leave on Saturday, so it might be convenient.

lines.zh: 假期的计划还没定，我也不一定知道几点方便。我们先商量，听对方的意见。
lines.py: jià qī de jì huà hái méi dìng , wǒ yě bù yí dìng zhī dào jǐ diǎn fāng biàn . wǒ men xiān shāng liang , tīng duì fāng de yì jian .
lines.en: Holiday plans are not settled, and I do not necessarily know what time is convenient. We will discuss it and hear each other’s opinions.

lines.zh: 我打算先休息，心情好一点再见朋友。她改变了原来的计划。
lines.py: wǒ dǎ suan xiān xiū xī , xīn qíng hǎo yī diǎn zài jiàn péng you . tā gǎi biàn le yuán lái de jì huà .
lines.en: I plan to rest first and meet friends when I feel better. She changed the original plan.

lines.zh: 她让我放心：今晚不来，没有关系；明天告诉她，再改时间。
lines.py: tā ràng wǒ fàng xīn : jīn wǎn bù lái , méi yǒu guān xì ; míng tiān gào sù tā , zài gǎi shí jiān .
lines.en: She reassured me: not coming tonight is okay; tell her tomorrow, then change the time.

lines.zh: 我没有说一定星期六六点见。我们答应明天再定，不能把一个想法当成最后的计划。
lines.py: wǒ méi yǒu shuō yí dìng xīng qī liù liù diǎn jiàn . wǒ men dā ying míng tiān zài dìng , bù néng bǎ yī gè xiǎng fa dàng chéng zuì hòu de jì huà .
lines.en: I did not promise Saturday at six. We agreed to decide tomorrow; an idea is not the final plan.

right.py: zán men zì jǐ xiān kàn , xiǎo zǔ de shū dú dǒng le ma ?
right.en: Let us check for ourselves first; have we understood the group’s book?

pairs.left: You may go; he might come. Is everyone here? Let us begin.

right.zh: 你可以去，他可能会来。大家来了？开始吧。
right.py: nǐ kě yǐ qù , tā kě néng huì lái . dà jiā lái le ? kāi shǐ ba .
right.en: You may go; he might come. Is everyone here? Let us begin.

right.py: nǐ zài wǎng shàng mǎi de ma ?

pairs.left: Book and notebook; a new book; read a book; understand by reading; everyone has arrived.

right.zh: 书和本子，新的书，读书，读懂，大家来了。
right.py: shū hé běn zi , xīn de shū , dú shū , dú dǒng , dà jiā lái le .
right.en: Book and notebook; a new book; read a book; understand by reading; everyone has arrived.

pairs.left: I am at home; what about you?

right.en: I am at home; what about you?

natural.zh: 谢谢你，今晚不方便，还是改天吧。
natural.py: xiè xiè nǐ , jīn wǎn bù fāng biàn , hái shi gǎi tiān ba .
natural.en: Thank you; tonight is inconvenient. Let us choose another day.

pragmatics.note: Give a truthful reason at the detail level you want; willingness need not imply availability.

natural.zh: 也许星期六方便，明天告诉你。
natural.py: yě xǔ xīng qī liù fāng biàn , míng tiān gào sù nǐ .
natural.en: Perhaps Saturday is convenient; I will tell you tomorrow.

pragmatics.note: Say clearly what is undecided instead of leaving a tentative suggestion as a promise.

conversation.title: Maybe another night
conversation.context: Decline warmly and suggest another plan.
conversation.goal: Decline an invitation without pretending to agree

turns.intent: Decline warmly and offer another day
examples: 今晚不方便，还是改天吧。
